The only hash the product computes is SHA-256 (
); no MD5 or SHA-1 appears in
The project implements no cryptographic algorithms and exposes no algorithm choice; signing and verification are delegated to Sigstore, and transport security to Node TLS.

Offing stores no authentication credentials or private keys. The GitHub token is read per run from the action input or environment, and the Sigstore trusted root is public data shipped in the package.
Every network path is HTTPS: signed data releases, the optional GitHub API comment, and the user's own package install (
). There is no FTP, plain HTTP, or other insecure transport.
/undici, which requires TLS 1.2 or newer by default; no custom TLS version or cipher configuration exists in
; certificate verification stays at the Node default.
The only private value sent over the network is the GitHub token in a request header, and it goes through
only after the TLS handshake, with no plain-HTTP path (
) sign binaries and checksums with keyless Sigstore, add a build-provenance attestation and SLSA provenance, and sign the image digest too;
documents the public verification commands. Keys are short-lived OIDC identities, never stored on the distribution site.
and no published key or verification instructions exist.
